# Prepare data

```{r read.in.new.data}
counts = read.csv("../data/rh_abx_cohort_rarefied_counts.csv",
                  colClasses = c(X = "character"))
colnames(counts)[1] <- "public_client_id"
counts$days_in_program <- NULL

# Specifying colClass so leading 0 is not dropped
# Using this one bc I added stool vendor already
metadata = read.csv("../data/abx_covariates_with_statins_a1c_all_covars.csv",
                    colClasses = c(public_client_id = "character"))

filtered_metadata = filter(metadata, public_client_id %in% counts$public_client_id)
```

```{r remove.zero.columns}
# Name is the variable for ASVs
# Value is their count
counts = counts %>% pivot_longer(-public_client_id) %>%  # Rows are person, ASVs count
  group_by(public_client_id) %>%                         # Groups by person
  group_by(name) %>%                                     # Group by taxa  
  mutate(total = sum(value)) %>%                         # Sums ASVS over all folks
  filter(total != 0) %>%                                 # Keep taxa that not 0
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = public_client_id) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Add clients as row names, drop that id column
rownames(counts) <- counts$public_client_id
counts$public_client_id <- NULL

# Need to have it in matrix form for vegan
counts_matrix <- as.matrix(counts)
```

```{r read.dist}
dist_jaccard <- readRDS("../data/rh_distance_matrix_jaccard.rds")
dist_bray <- readRDS("../data/rh_distance_matrix_bray.rds")
```

# Perform PCOA

```{r load.pcoa.result}
# Remember this is not just the coordinates; it's the whole object (with eig)
pcoa_result_jaccard <- readRDS("../data/abx_recency_pcoa_jaccard.rds")
pcoa_result_bray <- readRDS("../data/abx_recency_pcoa_bray.rds")

# Result coord with group info
pcoa_df_bray <- read.csv("../data/abx_recency_pcoa_df_bray.csv", 
                    colClasses = c(public_client_id = "character"))
pcoa_df_jaccard <- read.csv("../data/abx_recency_pcoa_df_jaccard.csv", 
                    colClasses = c(public_client_id = "character"))

pcoa_df_bray$abx_recency <- factor(pcoa_df_bray$abx_recency, levels = c("none", "twelve", "three"))
pcoa_df_jaccard$abx_recency <- factor(pcoa_df_jaccard$abx_recency, levels = c("none", "twelve", "three"))
```

# Plot and save

```{r plot.fxn}
plot_pcoa <- function(pcoa, pcoa_df, ax1, ax2) {
  eigenvalues <- pcoa$eig
  total_variance <- sum(eigenvalues[eigenvalues > 0])
  percent_explained <- pcoa$eig / total_variance * 100
  
  rounded_pe <- format(round(percent_explained[1:2], digits=1), nsmall=1)
  coord_one_lab <- c(glue("Pco 1 ({rounded_pe[1]}%)"))
  coord_two_lab <- c(glue("Pco 2 ({rounded_pe[2]}%)"))
  
  my_palette <- c(
  "none" = "#007ea7", 
  "twelve" = "#80ced7", 
  "three" = "darkgrey")
  
  ordination_plot <- ggplot(
    pcoa_df,
    aes(x = {{ax1}}, y = {{ax2}}, color = abx_recency, fill = abx_recency)) +
    stat_ellipse(geom  = "polygon", alpha = 0.1, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha=0.9, shape= 21, stroke=0.25, color="black") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = my_palette) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_palette, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = "PCoA",
      x = coord_one_lab,
      y = coord_two_lab,
    color = "Antibiotic use recency") +
  theme_minimal()
  
  # --- top marginal: distribution along PCoA1 ---
  top_marg <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = {{ax1}}, y = abx_recency, fill = abx_recency)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.size = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_palette) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank())
  # --- right marginal: distribution along PCoA2 ---
  right_marg <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = abx_recency, y = {{ax2}}, fill = abx_recency)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.size = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_palette) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank())
  # --- assemble; ratios control how thick the marginal strips are ---
  p <- ordination_plot |>
    insert_top(top_marg, height = 0.25) |>
    insert_right(right_marg, width = 0.25)

  return(p)
}
```


```{r plot.jaccard, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
jaccard <- plot_pcoa(pcoa_result_jaccard, pcoa_df_jaccard, pcoa1, pcoa2)
jaccard
# ggsave(filename = "../figures/pcoa_jaccard.pdf", plot = jaccard,
#        width = 5, height = 4, units = "in")
```

bray
